title: Sequencer.js flipper start assigns the solver slot to itself
summary: Sequencer.js indigo_flipper.start() assigned indigo_sequencer.devices[SOLVER_AGENT] to this.devices[SOLVER_AGENT] although the only caller already sets indigo_flipper.devices to the sequencer's array; misleading dead code from f7f2b3257. Remove the line.

resolution.evidence: Line removed from Sequencer.js; test-agent-scripting-sequencer.log 30/30 in verification.md.
